```{r score BIS BAS}
# Code script to score the Behavioral Inhibtion/Behavioral Activation Scale - Carver & White (1994) and Muris et al. (2005)
# https://doi.org/10.1037/0022-3514.67.2.319
# https://doi-org.proxy.library.upenn.edu/10.1016/j.paid.2004.06.007
# Scoring instructions: Sum the raw scores from each of the items corresponding to each subscale:
  #items 1-7 = BIS, where lower score = more inhibition;
  #items 8-12 = BAS reward responsiveness, where lower score = more reward responsiveness
  #items 13-16 = BAS Drive, where lower score = more driven
  #items 17-20 = BAS Fun Seeking, where lower score = more fun-seeking
  #items 8-20 = BAS total


# Load required packages (optional, for tidy syntax)
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
BIS_BAS <- read_tsv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/separate_tsvs/bisbias_child.tsv") #typo, fix if you fix the typo in earlier script

# Compute total scores for each individual participant
BIS_BAS <- BIS_BAS %>%
  mutate(
    bisbas_child_5_r = (5-bisbas_child_5) #reverse-score item 5 in BIS scale
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bissc_total = rowSums(select(., bisbas_child_1, bisbas_child_2, bisbas_child_3, bisbas_child_4, bisbas_child_5_r, bisbas_child_6, bisbas_child_7), na.rm = TRUE),
    bas_drive = rowSums(select(., bisbas_child_13, bisbas_child_14, bisbas_child_15, bisbas_child_16), na.rm = TRUE),
    bas_fs = rowSums(select(., bisbas_child_17, bisbas_child_18, bisbas_child_19, bisbas_child_20), na.rm = TRUE),
    bas_rr = rowSums(select(., bisbas_child_8, bisbas_child_9, bisbas_child_10, bisbas_child_11, bisbas_child_12), na.rm = TRUE),
    bas_total = rowSums(select(., bisbas_child_8, bisbas_child_9, bisbas_child_10, bisbas_child_11, bisbas_child_12, bisbas_child_13, bisbas_child_14, bisbas_child_15, bisbas_child_16, bisbas_child_17, bisbas_child_18, bisbas_child_19, bisbas_child_20), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(-bisbas_child_5_r) #drop temporary reverse-scored column from final df/tsv
write_tsv(BIS_BAS,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/bisbas_child.tsv", na = "n/a")
```
``` {r BIS BAS distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

BIS_BAS %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bissc_total)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "BIS total score", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of BIS total scores")

BIS_BAS %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bas_rr)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "BAS Reward Responsiveness", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of BAS Reward Responsiveness scores")

BIS_BAS %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bas_drive)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "BAS Drive", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of BAS Drive scores")

BIS_BAS %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bas_fs)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "BAS Fun Seeking", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of BAS Fun Seeking scores")

BIS_BAS %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = bas_total)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "BAS total score", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of BAS total scores")


```
